description: Stable contract-level error codes (§4.2, §6.2, §6.3, §9.7). Hosts and adapters return these codes verbatim in a machine-readable `code` field for the conditions listed here; scope post-v1 codes are reserved (v1 never sends targets or merges human text). Ordinary transport errors (401 unauthenticated, 400 malformed request, 404 not found, 413 too large, 5xx) keep standard HTTP semantics and are not part of this catalogue.

codes.meaning: Same op key, different bytes. A bug; surfaced, never retried.
A citation does not resolve to a person turn or document segment in the hydrated closure, or its chain passes through assistant records.
Accept or replace on a proposal that a replacement already superseded.
Replace on an accepted proposal; acceptance is terminal for the item in v1.
Proposal or accept with a target whose base moved.
Another proposal was already accepted on the same target.
The target has no recorded content to refine.
The target's current text was written by a person; no automatic merge.
The token's gen is not the session's current worker generation.
The auth epoch changed or a tombstone exists (409 per §6.3 on every fenced route); stop capture, output and new claims.
Unsupported major, or reader minor below min_reader.
The hold was already claimed; a resend needs a new attempt, hold and claim.
Claim on a hold that recover() already finalised (void, settled or unknown); a new attempt needs a new hold.
Admission refused at a session, principal/day or tenant/day cap, or for missing evidence.
The extension namespace, major or exact declared minor is not registered.
The extension descriptor, evolution, instance shape or typed data is invalid.
An extension count, canonical byte, string, array or schema depth limit was exceeded.

port_results.result: admit denied (session, principal/day or tenant/day cap, missing evidence)
stale worker generation on any fenced route
auth epoch changed or tombstone present
second claim on a claimed hold
claim after recover() finalised the hold
same op key or attempt id with different bytes

design_diagnostics_description: Stable local renderer and lint diagnostics for screen vocabulary v1. These do not extend journal, intake or ledger port result codes.

design_diagnostics.meaning: Screen IR shape, canonical JSON or semantic constraint invalid.
Design token shape or typed CSS value invalid.
Design canonical byte, node count or nesting limit exceeded.
Screen-local node ids are not unique.
A link target is not a screen-local node id.
The persisted renderer version is not implemented.
Design input record, acknowledgement or hydrated bytes disagree.
Render port deadline expired before or during work.
A render port attempt is still active.
Design lint diagnostic: a visible label contains only whitespace.
